recent.text: On November 14, 2016, Rogie Vachon was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame. In seven seasons with the @LAKings, Vachon set goaltending records for games played (389), wins (171) and shutouts (32), and was the first Hart Trophy finalist in franchise history. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/HlYnZVXEJF

recent.text: On November 14, 2013, Tanner Pearson scored his first career NHL goal in his regular season debut with the @LAKings.
